sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 12 March 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000002-P1 was put before Maple Grove Regional Hospital 002 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Pneumococcal minimum take of 520 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
